title: Bubble Reef Rush Level File Schema
description: Defines the structure of a .brl level file for Bubble Reef Rush. All .brl files are stored under assets/levels/. Player-created levels use the same schema and are stored under user://levels/.

schema_version.description: Schema version string. Increment minor on backwards-compatible additions, major on breaking changes.

id.description: Unique level identifier. Official levels use format 'z{zone}-l{level}' (e.g. 'z1-l1'). Player-created levels use a UUID v4.

name.description: Display name shown on the level select screen. 3–40 characters.

description.description: Optional short description shown on level select hover/tap. 0–120 characters.

zone.description: Zone number (1–6 official; 7 = Space Bubble station stub). Determines background defaults, obstacle availability, and unlock chain.

level_index.description: Level's position within its zone (1–8 for official levels). Not required for player-created levels.

bpm.description: Primary BPM of the level. For variable-BPM levels (Zone 5), this is the starting BPM. Used to calculate default beat_interval_ms = (60 / bpm) * 1000.

bpm_variable.description: If true, bpm may change mid-level via bpm_changes array. Only permitted for Zone 5 levels and Zone 5-style player-created levels. When true, timing windows recalculate in real time.

bpm_changes.description: Array of BPM change events for variable-BPM levels. Only read when bpm_variable is true. Events are processed in beat_index order.

beat_index.description: Beat on which the BPM change begins.

transition_beats.description: Number of beats over which to linearly interpolate from current BPM to new_bpm. Set to 0 for instant change.

difficulty.description: Difficulty rating 1–8. 1–2 = Beginner (Z1 early), 3–4 = Intermediate (Z1 late/Z2), 5–6 = Advanced (Z3–Z4), 7–8 = Expert (Z5–Z6). Used for level select display and search filtering.

difficulty_tag.description: Human-readable difficulty label. Automatically computed by the editor from obstacle density and speed; can be manually overridden DOWN but not UP.

author.description: For official levels: 'Bubble Reef Rush Team'. For player-created levels: the player's chosen display name (sanitized, 3–20 chars, no PII).

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of level creation. Set by the game engine on first save, not editable in the level editor UI.

is_official.description: True for levels shipped with the game. False for all player-created levels. Controls which moderation rules apply.

total_beats.description: Total number of beats in this level. Equal to the beat count of the referenced music track. Used by the game to know when to end the level.

tags.description: Optional creator-defined tags for community gallery search. Max 5 tags, each 2–20 chars, lowercase, no spaces.

level_type.description: Special level type. 'standard' is the default gameplay mode.

character_id.description: For character_trial levels: the character ID unlocked on completion.

boss_id.description: For boss_chase levels: the boss script ID.

trial_unlock_id.description: For trial levels: the unlock ID granted on completion.

music.description: Reference to the music track and playback settings.

filename.description: Path to the audio file relative to assets/audio/music/. Use .ogg for production (Godot 4 streaming); .wav is accepted during development. Example: 'zone_1_sunlit_shallows.ogg'

loop.description: Whether the track loops. False for all official levels (fixed length). True is permitted for player-created levels that want a repeating backdrop.

loop_start_beat.description: Beat index where the loop restarts from. Only used when loop is true.

preview_start_beat.description: Beat where the level select preview clip starts playing.

preview_duration_beats.description: How many beats the level select preview plays before looping.

beat_offset_ms.description: Audio-to-beat alignment offset in milliseconds. Positive = music starts before beat 0. Negative = music starts after beat 0. Used to correct for audio file silence at start or late downbeat.

volume_db.description: Playback volume adjustment in decibels relative to the master music bus. Used to normalize loudness across tracks.

beat_map.description: Ordered array of all obstacles in this level. Must be sorted by beat_index ascending. Multiple entries may share the same beat_index (simultaneous obstacles in different lanes).

beat_index.description: Which beat this obstacle appears on, counting from 0. Beat 0 is the first beat of the level. May be a decimal for subdivisions: 0.5 = eighth note, 0.25 = sixteenth note.

beat_subdivision.description: Subdivision label for editor display. Does not affect gameplay — beat_index encodes the actual position.

obstacle_type.description: Slug of the obstacle type to spawn. Must match an entry in the obstacle catalog.

lane_position.description: Normalized vertical position (0.0 = top of playfield, 1.0 = bottom). For wall-attached obstacles (coral_spike, eel_snap, current_jet), this is the wall attachment point. For free-floating obstacles (jellyfish, bubble_mine), this is the initial center Y.

parameters.description: Obstacle-specific parameters. Keys depend on obstacle_type. See obstacle_catalog.md for valid keys per type. Only include keys relevant to the obstacle type — extra keys are ignored.

wall_attachment.description: coral_spike, eel_snap, current_jet: which wall the obstacle attaches to.

height.description: coral_spike: height of spike cluster in pixels.

sine_amplitude.description: jellyfish_drift: vertical oscillation amplitude in pixels.

sine_frequency.description: jellyfish_drift: vertical oscillation frequency in Hz.

sway_speed.description: kelp_curtain: sway angular frequency in rad/s used directly in sin(time * sway_speed + phase). Range: 1.5 (intro, gentle) to 3.0 (hard, rapid). Matches KelpCurtain.gd _sway_speed.

gap_beat_alignment.description: kelp_curtain: beat index when the gap is fully open. Must fall within a beat window after placement beat.

arm_radius.description: bubble_mine: proximity radius in pixels that triggers the warning pulse.

beat_phase_offset.description: current_jet, anchor_chain: fractional beat offset for the obstacle's cycle start.

cycle_beats.description: current_jet: total beats per fire/cooldown cycle.

max_angle_degrees.description: anchor_chain: maximum swing arc in degrees from vertical.

pendulum_frequency.description: anchor_chain: pendulum swing frequency in Hz.

wall_origin.description: lava_burst: wall the eruption originates from.

x_position.description: lava_burst: normalized horizontal position of vent (0.0–1.0).

dormant_beats.description: lava_burst, eel_snap: number of beats the obstacle stays dormant between activations.

strike_length.description: eel_snap: how far the eel extends in pixels.

entry_side.description: pressure_wall, crystal_shard: side the obstacle enters from.

gap_y_normalized.description: pressure_wall: normalized vertical center of the safe gap.

gap_height.description: pressure_wall: height of safe gap in pixels.

travel_speed.description: pressure_wall: lateral travel speed in pixels/sec.

duration_beats.description: dark_void: number of beats the void effect lasts.

pulse_with_beat.description: dark_void: if true, the visibility cutout pulses in radius on each beat.

lateral_speed.description: crystal_shard: horizontal travel speed in pixels/sec.

diagonal_speed_initial.description: crystal_shard: initial vertical direction of travel.

delay_frames.description: mirror_fish: number of frames behind player position the mirror fish is (at 60fps).

approach_speed_bonus.description: mirror_fish: additional px/sec on top of scroll speed for the mirror fish's approach.

speed_zones.description: Array of speed modification zones. Speed multipliers affect horizontal scroll speed only, not physics. Zones must not overlap. Sorted by start_beat ascending.

start_beat.description: Beat index where this speed zone begins.

end_beat.description: Beat index where this speed zone ends (exclusive — the beat at end_beat uses the next zone's speed or default 1.0).

speed_multiplier.description: Scroll speed multiplier relative to the base speed. 1.0 = normal. 0.5 = half speed (slower). 2.0 = double speed. Range 0.25–2.5.

transition_beats.description: Number of beats to linearly ramp from the previous speed to this speed_multiplier. 0 = instant snap.

label.description: Optional editor-only label for this speed zone (e.g. 'Slow Buildup', 'Rush Sequence'). Not shown in-game.

background.description: Background and visual layer references for this level.

asset_key.description: Key referencing the background asset set in the BackgroundManager autoload. Corresponds to a named entry in assets/backgrounds/backgrounds_manifest.json.

parallax_enabled.description: Whether parallax scrolling is active for this level. Disable for very low-end devices (auto-disabled via quality preset).

color_override.description: Optional hex color string (#RRGGBB) to tint the entire background. null = no override, use asset defaults. Used by Zone 6 to apply prismatic color cycling via shader.

shader_key.description: Optional shader override key. References shaders/backgrounds/ directory. 'heat_wave' for Z4, 'depth_distort' for Z5, 'prismatic_cycle' for Z6, null for others.

ambient_particle_key.description: Key for the ambient particle system to run in this level (e.g. 'bubbles_light', 'deep_sea_motes', 'volcanic_ash', 'crystal_dust'). null = none.

unlock_requirements.description: Conditions that must be met before this level can be played. All listed conditions must be satisfied simultaneously.

min_stars_zone_previous.description: Minimum total stars earned in the previous zone. null = no zone star requirement. Used to gate Z6 (requires all stars in Z1–Z5).

required_level_id.description: Level ID that must be completed (any star rating) before this level is accessible. null = no prerequisite level. Typically set to the fourth level of the previous zone (e.g. 'z1-l4' to unlock Zone 2).

required_level_stars.description: Minimum star rating required on the required_level_id. 1 = any completion. Ignored if required_level_id is null.

requires_full_reef_iap.description: If true, player must have purchased the Full Reef IAP ($2.99) to access this level. Always true for Z4 and Z5 levels.

requires_creator_pass.description: If true, player must own Creator Pass to access this level. Used only for community-published levels at creator's discretion (rare — most published levels are free to play).

min_total_stars.description: Minimum total stars across all zones. Used for Z6 unlock (requires 120 stars = 3 stars × 40 levels). null = no total stars requirement.

collectibles.description: Optional array of collectible items (pearls, bonus coins) placed on the beat grid. Added in schema v1.1. Absent field or empty array = no collectibles.

beat_index.description: Beat position where this collectible appears. Same coordinate space as beat_map entries.

beat_subdivision.description: Grid resolution this collectible was placed at in the editor.

collectible_type.description: Type of collectible. 'pearl' = primary collectible (Zone 1 onwards). 'bonus_coin' = bonus coin cluster triggered by crystal resonance (Zone 6 only).

lane_position.description: Normalized vertical position in the lane (0.0 = top, 1.0 = bottom).

par_score.description: Score thresholds for star ratings. Set manually by level designer. The game computes star count from final_score vs these thresholds.

one_star.description: Minimum score to earn 1 star (level completion threshold). Below this = 0 stars (level complete but no stars).

max_possible.description: Theoretical maximum score achievable on this level (all PERFECTs at max combo multiplier). Used by results screen to show percentage. Computed by the level editor automatically.
